versions.name: Camp Powhatan

features.note: eight-person adirondack shelters in several campsites
campfire area used for the opening and closing campfires
astronomy and space exploration badges
day trip to the reservation's own riding course and safety riders course
backpacking badge taught in the scoutcraft area
wireless internet for adult leaders only
electrical access in several campsites
day trip to a private wild cave near camp
weekly interfaith service held in the camp chapel
four-story tower at the camp COPE and climbing center
unit service projects on the reservation
nationally accredited low and high COPE course with high ropes elements
western-themed evening range with revolver, double-barrelled shotgun, and lever-action rifle
photography, animation, and game design badges
family-style meals served in two seatings
Brownsea Island, an all-day all-week program for newly joined Scouts working toward First Class
basketry, leatherwork, wood carving, and art in an open handicraft shelter
health lodge staffed around the clock by medical personnel
New River Adventure and scuba tracks based out of this camp
over one hundred miles of reservation trails
day trip to a partner farm for a riding lesson and trail ride
nature lodge built in collaboration with a university
ecology area covering forestry, geology, reptile study, and weather
New River Adventure for Scouts in their teens
open-air handicraft shelter, also used as the arrival gathering point
music badge offered as an evening class
revolver shooting within the cowboy action program
two-person canvas wall tents; primitive sites have bare tent platforms for unit-owned tents
rappelling from the climbing tower and from natural rock
day trip to natural rock faces in the river gorge
open-water certification course run with a partner dive shop
snorkeling instruction within the diving program
robotics, electronics, engineering, and game design badges
daily open swim plus learn-to-swim and mile swim certifications
camp store with a snack bar
an inflatable blob at the waterfront, launched from a jump off the lifeguard tower
mountain lake used for swimming, boating, and fishing
class two to four rapids on the river with an outfitter
wood carving in the handicraft area

versions.summary: Scouts BSA resident camp at Blue Ridge Scout Reservation in the Blue Ridge Mountains of Hiwassee, Virginia, operated by Blue Ridge Mountains Council.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types.
